Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Add a Penumbra/SimpleHeels status header, versioned window titles, a first-run welcome tutorial, and disabled-mod support in the animation picker (PoseKit now enables a mod temporarily when you play from it). Removed the redundant movable-window toggle.
